title: PI-Desktop packages a local-first coding agent with installable plugins
friendlyTitle: Run a local-first coding agent in a desktop app
summary: PI-Desktop is a local-first desktop coding-agent application built with Electron and a Rust host core, with provider configuration, workspace tools, permissions and user-installable plugins. The approximately 1,600-star project is under active development and publishes packaged releases alongside its source.
friendlySummary: PI-Desktop combines a desktop interface, a local Rust control service, coding tools and installable plugins. It can connect to different AI providers and manage access to a workspace.
whyItMatters: Developers can explore a desktop agent that keeps its control layer local while supporting different providers and extensions. Because plugins and workspace tools can execute powerful actions, inspect extensions, start with a disposable project and grant only the filesystem and command permissions required.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Test it first on a project you can replace. Check every plugin and give the agent only the files and commands it truly needs.
